pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. Standing on all fours, body foreshortened by camera angle.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The plates are seen rising in pairs behind the head.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: High-angle 'Down-Shot'. The camera is positioned significantly above the dinosaur and backed away, looking down onto its back plates. This compresses the body width.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The broad torso and tail are hidden behind the front of the body. The plates create a tall, tapering silhouette. Silhouette width max 280px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The highest, most prominent plates should form the apex of the silhouette, creating a distinctive, jagged 'mountain range' shape.

character_details.expression: Calm, gentle, and a bit placid; small, kind eyes.
character_details.texture: Smooth, leathery skin with clean, sharply defined, chunky plates. Color: Earthy golden-brown body with vibrant, moss-green plates and cream-colored thagomizers (tail spikes).
features: Double row of large, diamond-shaped dorsal plates.
Small head relative to its body size.

environmental_details.ground: Dry, cracked mud with scattered, low-lying Jurassic ferns and river pebbles, characteristic of the Morrison Formation.
flora: Sparse, stylized cycads and conifers in the soft-focus background, suggesting an open, semi-arid landscape.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, clear, sun-baked Late Jurassic sky with a warm, golden haze, enhancing the feeling of an expansive, ancient world.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed Cinematic' lighting, with strong top-down light emphasizing the texture and angularity of the plates, creating dramatic highlights.
